floor_map.scale_note: metric scale from average adult eye height; no surveyed floor plan

reasons: co-observed people agree within 0.573 m (p90), not within 0.5 m
room walls meet 15.7 deg away from square: far-field distortion, positions near the far walls are less reliable
metric scale rests on an average eye-height prior (~5 % uncertainty)
landmark world positions are derived, not surveyed: they do not independently test accuracy

cross_camera_floor_agreement_m.what: same person at the same time, projected by each camera (people with visible feet or seated estimates)

calibration.method: RANSAC rigid on co-observed people (1 s bins), then joint least-squares refinement of both cameras
